pages.title: A Small Kitchen
pages.text: Build a compact workspace with water and heat.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Interact with the sink’s lower half; containers fill according to its native rules. The Small Cooking Pot needs heat and the recipe’s serving container.

pages.title: Cook a small meal
pages.text: The Small Cooking Pot is a separate heated workstation. It needs a compatible heat source and the recipe's container, not just inserted ingredients.

pages.title: Draw kitchen water
pages.text: Interact with the sink's lower half. It accepts water and fills supported containers through its native interaction.

pages.title: Arrange bakery displays
pages.text: A Tray uses individual positions. A Wall Display accepts food and bread, while a Cupcake Display allows more flexible decoration.
